title: Music Row Queen Cottage – ADA Accessible
description:
Enjoy a quiet ADA-accessible Queen Cottage on Music Row with a private entrance and patio. This cozy retreat features step-free access, a walk-in shower, and a comfortable queen bed. Relax in our courtyard with mini golf, BBQ grills, seating, and cornhole. Walk to RCA Studio B, Belmont, Vanderbilt, and Edgehill Village. Just 11 minutes to Broadway. Fast WiFi, smart TV, parking, and easy self check-in included.

The space
Originally home to Nashville’s rising singer-songwriters, this 1950s building has been fully reimagined into boutique cottages while preserving the original Music Row character.

Your private ADA Queen Cottage includes:

• Private entry + private patio
• Queen bed with premium linens
• ADA-compliant bathroom with walk-in shower & grab bars
• Step-free access & wide interior doorways
• Kitchenette with fridge, microwave, coffee maker & essentials
• Cozy living area with Smart TV & fast Wi-Fi
• Individual climate control for year-round comfort

A charming Nashville hideaway designed for accessibility, comfort, and ease.

Guest access
Guests have full access to the entire ADA Queen Cottage and all shared Harmony House amenities:

• Mini golf course (equipment provided)
• Courtyard with BBQ grills, dining tables, lounge seating
• Cornhole boards for a little friendly competition
• Free on-site parking with step-free access to the unit
• Keyless self-check-in with secure smart lock

Whether you’re visiting campuses, recording studios, medical appointments, or downtown Nashville, everything is designed for independence and convenience.

Other things to note
• This cottage is fully ADA-accessible, with step-free entry, wide doorways, and a walk-in ADA-compliant shower.
• Harmony House is a multi-unit property — expect light activity around the shared courtyard and mini golf area.
• Quiet hours after 10pm to respect our peaceful, residential neighborhood.
• One dog under 50 lbs allowed with a $75 fee (no cats, please).
• No smoking or vaping anywhere on the property.
• Professionally cleaned before each stay; additional linens available on request.
• Free parking is included for one vehicle; additional spaces available upon request.
